evidence: Conditional synthetic enterprise; no observed customers, frontier execution, ENS authentication, collections or revenue

evidence_labels.numerical_replay_distribution: calibrated empirical replay; not a customer-demand or reliability estimate

policy_freeze.limits: Finite common price grid, declared reference belief and one-opportunity contribution objective. Includes estimated correction/default/refund/processing costs; excludes fixed overhead, capacity competition and learning. Not a global optimum or observed customer price.

campaign_costs.evidence: Observed local runtime; conversion uses a sourced equipment-rate proxy. Human work is estimated.

statistical_limits: Monte Carlo variability is conditional on declared profiles and empirical numerical replay. More seeds do not validate demand, quality, price, labour, or access assumptions.
